turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, I need the order number (like SC-1234) and the email address used for the order. Could you send both?
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up an order by name. To keep your order private, I need both the order number and the email used for the order before I can share anything. If you can find them, for example in your confirmation email, send them here and I'll check right away.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, but I can't share the delivery address or the shipping status until I have verified the order. I need the order number and the email used for the order. Once you have them, send them here and I'll check right away.
